title: Italian White Bean Stuffed Portobellos with Quinoa
intro: Few ingredients and minimal prep make this plant-based dinner a fast weeknight staple. Meaty portobello caps serve as edible bowls for a savory bean and spinach filling, paired with a convenient quinoa pouch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F / 200°C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Brush the outsides of the portobello caps with the extra-virgin olive oil and place them gill-side up on the prepared baking sheet.
Mash half of the cannellini beans in a medium bowl using a fork. Stir in the remaining whole beans, spinach, marinara sauce, and garlic powder until combined.
Divide the bean and spinach mixture among the mushroom caps. Sprinkle the shredded mozzarella over the tops.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until the mushrooms are tender and the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Warm the quinoa in the microwave according to the pouch instructions while the mushrooms bake.
Serve the stuffed portobellos alongside the warm quinoa.
variation: Swap the baby spinach for finely chopped fresh kale.
conservation: Keeps 2 days refrigerated; reheat in the oven for 10 minutes.
